messages:
jules: Edge Labs opened SUP-9033 — they saw a $3.6k burst on their Dedicated reserved commit after running a local quantization tuning experiment. They want it refunded. Invoice INV-4580 attached.
rosa-fin: Can you paste the invoice line items?
jules: INV-4580 snippet:
```
INV-4580
- Reserved commit (Apr): $6,000
- Burst overage (04/09 18:10-18:40 UTC): $3,600
Total due: $9,600
```
sam-cs: Customer says they tried an internal model change during their dev window which increased token output and triggered autoscale. They admit it was their change but argue we should have better guardrails.
platform-bot: Note: scaling event 2026-04-09T18:09Z — autoscaler launched 4 extra nodes for 28 minutes. No platform incident recorded. (link)
rosa-fin: If this was customer-initiated (dev/experiment), default is billable. Any nuance?
sam-cs: They claim the autoscaler over-reacted because of a new model that had higher memory/latency characteristics; they wanted a more lenient burst cap. Asking for a one-time exception.
rosa-fin: We can do a goodwill exception but need approvals for non-contractual waivers. Suggest partial credit: cover 50% of burst since they did the experiment but our autoscaler sensitivity could be improved. That would be $1,800.
jules: Edge Labs also requested mitigation for future tests — can we offer a discounted sandbox bump for a month? They asked for 50% off an extra reserved slot for 30 days.
rosa-fin: Approve partial credit $1,800 + one-month sandbox promo 50% off an extra reserved slot (handled as a promo CN if needed). Tag reason=goodwill-experiment-exception.
billing-bot: Creating credit note CN-4580-1 amount $1,800 (reason: goodwill-experiment-exception). Placing hold on INV-4580 collection.
sam-cs: I'll communicate: "We reviewed and will apply a one-time $1,800 credit covering part of the burst, and offer a 50% discount on an add-on reserved slot for 30 days to support your experiments. Please let us know if you want help with test isolation."
rosa-fin: Filing FIN-996: "Add autoscaler sensitivity knobs & experimental sandbox offering" to product + platform. Assigning to platform owner.
jules: Thanks — will update the support ticket and confirm when CN posts. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
